awards.title: Best NGO Award — District Level
awards.description: Recognised for outstanding contribution to women empowerment and community development in rural Ajmer.

awards.title: Excellence in Rural Health Initiatives
awards.description: Awarded for successful immunisation drives and maternal health awareness campaigns across multiple blocks.

awards.title: Women Self-Help Group Champion
awards.description: Recognised for forming and sustaining over 40 Self Help Groups with exemplary savings and credit discipline.

awards.title: Green Village Award
awards.description: Honoured for large-scale plantation drives and environment conservation efforts across Sawar and Kishangarh blocks.

awards.title: Child Rights Advocacy Recognition
awards.description: Acknowledged for campaigns against child labour and successful re-enrolment of out-of-school children.

milestones.text: GMVS registered and begins operations in Bubani, Ajmer
First Self Help Groups formed with 200 rural women
Stitching and tailoring training centre established
Learning centres opened in 5 remote hamlets
Child labour awareness campaign enrolled 60 children back to school
Sustainable agriculture training expanded to 3 blocks
Crossed 500+ active SHG members across 40+ groups
Digital literacy programme launched for rural youth
